Governmental figures from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); beginning/ending cash = fund balances rolled forward (cash 1,177,478 less payroll withholding 3,000 at year end). Transfers: governmental net 'Transfers from (to) other funds' 29,679 in (p5), proprietary -29,679 (p7). Taxes are printed by type on p5, no split needed. Business-type: proprietary statement Total column (p7); no single total, receipts/disbursements computed; nonoperating loan forgiveness, interest expense and loan fees are disbursements. Proprietary cash flow statement (pp8-9) not recorded in 'proprietary' (report basis is not GAAP for governmental funds). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), Primary Government Total column (includes capital assets and long-term debt); component unit (CRA) excluded. Detail: General Fund from the departments combining schedule (pp14-15, 7 department columns), which supersedes the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10, not recorded to avoid double counting); Street, Debt Service and Sales Tax funds from their budgetary comparison schedules (pp11-13). Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule. Read pages 1-15 of 15
